title: The Mirror Maze
text: In a maze of mirrors, the reflections walk a step behind you, always a heartbeat slow. One of them is a step ahead instead. It keeps glancing back over its shoulder, as if to see whether you are following.

options.label: The sharpest follows the reflection that walks ahead, wherever it leads.

outcomes.text: It leads you out the far side and waves goodbye.
It leads you to its friends. They step out of the glass.

options.label: Smash your way through the mirrors, leaving the reflections in pieces.

outcomes.text: Glass is everywhere and every hand is bloody. The reflections laugh at you from the shards.

options.label: The shrewdest tricks the reflection into a mirror it cannot leave.

outcomes.text: It walks into a mirror and does not come out. The glass goes dark behind it.
